keyEvents.text: Goal! Barnsley 1, Aldershot Town 0. Cameron McGeehan (Barnsley) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Jubril Okedina.
Goal! Barnsley 2, Aldershot Town 0. Reyes Cleary (Barnsley) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Tobi Adeyemo.
Sam Gale (Barnsley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Barnsley 3, Aldershot Town 0. Vimal Yoganathan (Barnsley) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Luca Connell.
Goal! Barnsley 4, Aldershot Town 0. Vimal Yoganathan (Barnsley) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Reyes Cleary.
